name: Floating Bonsai Islands
description: Tiny floating islands carrying ancient bonsai trees and miniature waterfalls over a misty valley.
prompt: A single serene fantasy landscape: several small floating islands drifting above a misty green valley, each island topped with a sculptural bonsai tree, tiny cascading waterfalls spilling into open air, mossy rocks, glowing morning fog, distant mountains, birds gliding between islands, soft golden light, hyper-detailed, tranquil, no text, no logos, no watermarks.
caption: Some gardens don’t need roots. 🌿☁️ Which floating bonsai would you live on?
